text_block_list.text:
"...I lost again...!
No matter how many times I try... I...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've received so much from everyone...!
If I don't win, there's no meaning to my—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I lose...
I'll never be the one to give up.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Because there are so many people I want to show my victory to... Dad, Mom, my doctor—and my Trainer."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I will keep running.
If I can't win, I'll run until I can."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to make that dream come true!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'm sorry.
That was a mean question to ask, wasn't it...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I will work even harder from now on.
Until I can repay everyone for their support.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*! Damn it!
Why am I so weak...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She thinks that giving it her all and still losing
means she simply lacks the ability to win...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that wasn't true at all. Because—there's
no way I could be weak after receiving everyone's support!”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I won't hesitate anymore! Next time for sure,
I'll run a race worthy of everyone's support!"
